desc:
GET CLAPPED BY HULK 
One player becomes the HULK. Everyone else must SURVIVE!

🛡️ SURVIVORS: grab your M4, open crates for items, roll a hero with the HERO SERUM and shoot the Hulk down — or just outlast the clock.
💪 HULK: smash walls, clap, roar, charge and leap across the map. Clap them ALL before they take you down!

🎮 CONTROLS
Survivor:
• LMB — shoot / push
• Q — hero ability
• Shift — sprint
• C — slide
• E (hold) — open crates / grab items
• 1-3 — use items
• Ctrl — camera lock
• B — emotes

Hulk:
• LMB — punch
• Q — clap
• E — roar
• Shift — charge
• Hold Space — charged leap

📱 Mobile & 🎮 gamepad supported!

🎰 Spin the Hulk Crate for rare skins: Thanos, Venom & more!
👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite the game, really helps!
